module_summary: Two-state Lemmings Moore FSM: a 1-bit direction register toggles on the relevant bump input; outputs decode the state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Walking direction register (left/right), toggled by bumps.

anchors.name: bump_left
anchors.why: Switches walking-left state to walking right.

anchors.name: bump_right
anchors.why: Switches walking-right state to walking left.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state WL; walk_right is its complement.

groups.name: direction_fsm
groups.description: Direction state register, bump-driven next state, decoded walk outputs.
